name: DCDiag success rates and failure counts
description: Per DC and test: passed, failed, unknown observations and success percentage. KccEvent counts are included. Unrecognized/missing states are counted separately; no passed/failed observations yields an unknown percentage.
kql:
DCDiagData_CL
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| mv-expand Test = dynamic(['Advertising','ObjectsReplicated','NetLogons','KccEvent','Services','CheckSecurityError','KnowsOfRoleHolders','Connectivity','SysVolCheck','RidManager','Topology','MachineAccount','LocatorCheck','Replications']) to typeof(string)
| extend State = tostring(todynamic(Status)[Test])
| summarize Passed = countif(State =~ 'Passed'), Failed = countif(State =~ 'Failed'), Unknown = countif(State !~ 'Passed' and State !~ 'Failed'), LastObservation = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer, Test
| extend SuccessPercent = iff(Passed + Failed > 0, round(100.0 * Passed / (Passed + Failed), 1), real(null))
| project Computer, Test, SuccessPercent, Failed, Passed, Unknown, LastObservation
| order by Computer asc, Test asc
